scope: Synchronous snapshot integration; async and hybrid storage deferred
backend: Snapshot ownership includes verified subject, session and schema/column grants
refresh_of references previous owned snapshot; repeated refresh reuses replacement
agent: Existing credential verifier and SessionCatalog supply JWT/session/server scope
Four REST routes; preserves request body, query parameters, JSON/status and Retry-After
CSV streamed; closes upstream/client; broken stream aborts
Transport or malformed JSON failure gives canned 502

tests.test_limits: Automated tests use fake query streams/stores and mock HTTP transport, not deployed Ember or new live database runs. Release copy excludes private accrual YAML changes.

ember_required: Pass refresh_of=current snapshot ID on Refresh; retain reference on retries; replace session/UI snapshot only after 201. Removed snapshot 404: clear stale reference and create normally.
deployment: Set explicit agent REST base and allow synchronous request deadlines
Old caller-only snapshots require recreation; no insecure compatibility fallback
Already issued presigned URLs remain usable until their signed expiry
preserved: Private accrual YAML and existing staging untouched
